title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP12-ci2 — Windows portability smoke and P11.4 full certification
goal: Reduce repeated Windows Actions cost while retaining the required Windows check and its platform-sensitive evidence, full candidate coverage on Ubuntu, and one explicit Windows full-suite certification at P11.4.
acceptanceCriteria: Ordinary Windows runs execute the base-owned Validate gate plus the declared portability smoke, while Ubuntu ordinary runs execute the declared full candidate suite.

The 13 required check names, job DAG, event set, ruleset contexts and strict policy remain unchanged, and workflow_dispatch with windowsCoverage=full provides the P11.4 Windows full-suite certification.

ci/jobs.json declares both command sets and the certification entry point; the read-only CI contract and its negative controls fail closed on command, OS-selection or dispatch drift; package validation and the real pull request checks pass.
